steps.text: A new term has its own checklist.
Open New term in the top bar.

steps.caption: It lays out the start of every term, in order.

steps.text: Each card opens the right place to make the change.
Create the term, then set when enrollment opens and closes.
Then point each course at the new term, and post the term-start event.
It reads the website each time, so you can stop halfway.
Come back and press Check again. Done steps turn green.
